_comment: SKKU's own rest days (founding days, 학사휴교, etc.) on which the 인자셔틀 does not run. Two key forms: "MM-DD" recurs every year, "YYYY-MM-DD" applies once. Value = the Korean label shown on the day chip. Precedence: YYYY-MM-DD > MM-DD > Korean public holiday (date-holidays computes those, so they never go here). Any other key form throws at boot. Keys starting with "_" are ignored. A change needs a server deploy.
